# Template functions

tmplwatch templates are Go [`text/template`](https://pkg.go.dev/text/template)
programs. On top of the built-ins (`and`, `or`, `not`, `len`, `index`, `slice`,
`print`, `printf`, `println`, `eq`, `ne`, `lt`, `le`, `gt`, `ge`, `html`, `js`,
`urlquery`, `call`) tmplwatch provides 45 functions, 24 of them
named and behaving as in consul-template.

Every example below is executed by `go test ./internal/funcs` against this
key/value store, and the output column is checked byte for byte:

```text
motd = it's alive
service/web/conf = {"replicas":3,"tags":["blue","edge"]}
service/web/hosts/a = 10.0.0.1
service/web/hosts/b = 10.0.0.2
service/web/hosts/c/x = nested
service/web/port = 8080
```

Pipelines pass the previous value as the **last** argument, so functions take
their subject last (`"a.b" | replaceAll "." "_"`).

| Function | Group | consul-template |

## Key/value

### key

`key PATH → string`

Value at PATH. If PATH is absent the render is marked incomplete: nothing is written for that template and /healthz reports 503 until the key appears (consul-template blocks the same way).

```gotemplate
{{ key "service/web/port" }}
```

```text
8080
```

### keyOrDefault

`keyOrDefault PATH DEFAULT → string`

Value at PATH, or DEFAULT if absent. Never marks the render incomplete, but still records PATH as a dependency so a later write re-renders.

```gotemplate
{{ keyOrDefault "service/web/tls" "off" }}
```

```text
off
```

### keyExists

`keyExists PATH → bool`

Whether PATH exists. Records a dependency.

```gotemplate
{{ keyExists "motd" }} {{ keyExists "nope" }}
```

```text
true false
```

### ls

`ls PREFIX → []KVPair`

Immediate children of PREFIX that hold values, sorted by key. Each pair has `.Key` (relative to PREFIX) and `.Value`. Deeper keys are skipped, as in consul-template.

```gotemplate
{{ range ls "service/web/hosts" }}{{ .Key }}={{ .Value }} {{ end }}
```

```text
a=10.0.0.1 b=10.0.0.2 
```

### tree

`tree PREFIX → []KVPair`

Every key below PREFIX, recursively, sorted. `.Key` is relative to PREFIX and may contain slashes.

```gotemplate
{{ range tree "service/web/hosts" }}{{ .Key }} {{ end }}
```

```text
a b c/x 
```

## Environment

### env

`env NAME → string`

Environment variable NAME, or empty. Templates are trusted; see docs/SECURITY.md.

```gotemplate
{{ env "TMPLWATCH_EXAMPLE" }}
```

```text
example
```

### file

`file PATH → string`

Contents of PATH, which must be relative to the template's own directory (rooted with os.DirFS; `..` and absolute paths are refused). Not a dependency: edits to the file are seen on the next KV change or restart.

```gotemplate
{{ file "testdata/snippet.txt" | trimSpace }}
```

```text
from a file
```

### timestamp

`timestamp [LAYOUT] → string`

Current UTC time, RFC 3339 by default, else formatted with a Go layout; the special layout `unix` gives epoch seconds. Golden tests pin the clock.

```gotemplate
{{ timestamp }} {{ timestamp "2006-01-02" }}
```

```text
2026-01-02T03:04:05Z 2026-01-02
```

## Encoding

### toJSON

`toJSON VALUE → string`

Compact JSON. HTML characters are not escaped.

```gotemplate
{{ dict "a" 1 "b" (list "x" "<y>") | toJSON }}
```

```text
{"a":1,"b":["x","<y>"]}
```

### toPrettyJSON

`toPrettyJSON VALUE → string`

JSON indented by two spaces.

```gotemplate
{{ list 1 2 | toPrettyJSON }}
```

```text
[
  1,
  2
]
```

### parseJSON

`parseJSON STRING → any`

Decode JSON into maps, slices and scalars. Numbers keep their literal form (`51820`, never `5.182e+04`).

```gotemplate
{{ with parseJSON (key "service/web/conf") }}{{ .replicas }} {{ index .tags 1 }}{{ end }}
```

```text
3 edge
```

### toYAML

`toYAML VALUE → string`

Block-style YAML: sorted keys, two-space indent, strings quoted when YAML would misread them (`"yes"`, `"0755"`, `"a: b"`). No trailing newline; pair with `nindent`.

```gotemplate
{{ dict "on" "yes" "port" 80 "tags" (list "a" "b") | toYAML }}
```

```text
"on": "yes"
port: 80
tags:
  - a
  - b
```

### toHCL

`toHCL VALUE → string`

An HCL2 expression: quoted strings with `${` and `%{` escaped to `$${` and `%%{`, lists `[a, b]`, maps `{ k = v }` with sorted keys. Use it for every KV value placed in Terraform or Nomad files so data can never become interpolation.

```gotemplate
{{ toHCL "cost ${var.x}" }} {{ list "a" 1 true | toHCL }} {{ dict "b-c" 1 "a b" 2 | toHCL }}
```

```text
"cost $${var.x}" ["a", 1, true] { "a b" = 2, b-c = 1 }
```

### b64enc

`b64enc STRING → string`

Standard base64 encoding.

```gotemplate
{{ b64enc "hi" }}
```

```text
aGk=
```

### b64dec

`b64dec STRING → string`

Standard base64 decoding; fails on invalid input.

```gotemplate
{{ b64dec "aGk=" }}
```

```text
hi
```

### sha256sum

`sha256sum STRING → string`

Hex SHA-256, handy for config-hash annotations that force restarts.

```gotemplate
{{ sha256sum "abc" | printf "%.12s" }}
```

```text
ba7816bf8f01
```

### shq

`shq STRING → string`

POSIX shell single-quoting: the result is one word for /bin/sh whatever STRING contains.

```gotemplate
echo {{ key "motd" | shq }}
```

```text
echo 'it'\''s alive'
```

## Strings

### indent

`indent N STRING → string`

Prefix each non-empty line with N spaces.

```gotemplate
{{ "a\nb" | indent 2 }}
```

```text
  a
  b
```

### nindent

`nindent N STRING → string`

A newline, then `indent N`. The idiom for placing a block under a key.

```gotemplate
x:{{ "a: 1" | nindent 2 }}
```

```text
x:
  a: 1
```

### regexMatch

`regexMatch RE STRING → bool`

RE2 match (Go regexp). Compiled patterns are cached.

```gotemplate
{{ regexMatch "^[0-9]+$" (key "service/web/port") }}
```

```text
true
```

### regexReplaceAll

`regexReplaceAll RE REPL STRING → string`

Replace every match; REPL may use `$1` / `${name}`.

```gotemplate
{{ regexReplaceAll "([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)" "$2.$1" "web-01" }}
```

```text
01.web
```

### split

`split SEP STRING → []string`

strings.Split with the separator first, so it pipes.

```gotemplate
{{ range "a,b" | split "," }}[{{ . }}]{{ end }}
```

```text
[a][b]
```

### join

`join SEP LIST → string`

Join a []string, []any (elements printed with fmt) or []KVPair (values).

```gotemplate
{{ ls "service/web/hosts" | join ", " }}
```

```text
10.0.0.1, 10.0.0.2
```

### trimSpace

`trimSpace STRING → string`

strings.TrimSpace.

```gotemplate
[{{ "  x \n" | trimSpace }}]
```

```text
[x]
```

### toUpper

`toUpper STRING → string`

strings.ToUpper.

```gotemplate
{{ toUpper "web" }}
```

```text
WEB
```

### toLower

`toLower STRING → string`

strings.ToLower.

```gotemplate
{{ toLower "WEB" }}
```

```text
web
```

### replaceAll

`replaceAll OLD NEW STRING → string`

strings.ReplaceAll with the subject last, so it pipes.

```gotemplate
{{ "a.b.c" | replaceAll "." "_" }}
```

```text
a_b_c
```

### contains

`contains NEEDLE HAYSTACK → bool`

Substring of a string, element of a list, key of a map or of a []KVPair.

```gotemplate
{{ contains "b" (ls "service/web/hosts") }} {{ "edge" | contains "xy" }}
```

```text
true false
```

### plural

`plural ONE MANY N → string`

ONE if N is 1, else MANY.

```gotemplate
{{ $n := len (ls "service/web/hosts") }}{{ $n }} {{ plural "host" "hosts" $n }}
```

```text
2 hosts
```

## Network

### GetPrivateIP

`GetPrivateIP → string`

First private (RFC 1918 / RFC 4193) address on an up interface, IPv4 preferred; empty if none.

```gotemplate
{{ GetPrivateIP }}
```

Output depends on the host's interfaces.

### GetPublicIP

`GetPublicIP → string`

First global unicast address that is not private, IPv4 preferred; empty if none.

```gotemplate
{{ GetPublicIP }}
```

Output depends on the host's interfaces.

### GetInterfaceIP

`GetInterfaceIP NAME → string`

First address of interface NAME, IPv4 preferred; fails if NAME is unknown.

```gotemplate
{{ GetInterfaceIP "lo" }}
```

Output depends on the host's interfaces.

### GetAllInterfaces

`GetAllInterfaces → []Iface`

Every interface with `.Name .Index .MTU .Up .Loopback .Addrs` (CIDR strings).

```gotemplate
{{ range GetAllInterfaces }}{{ .Name }} {{ end }}
```

Output depends on the host's interfaces.

### sockaddr

`sockaddr EXPR → string`

consul-template compatibility shim. EXPR is one of `GetPrivateIP`, `GetPublicIP`, `GetInterfaceIP "NAME"`; the full go-sockaddr language is not implemented.

```gotemplate
{{ sockaddr "GetInterfaceIP \"lo\"" }}
```

Output depends on the host's interfaces.

## Math and data

### add

`add A B → int`

Integer sum. Operands may be ints, JSON numbers or numeric strings (KV values are strings).

```gotemplate
{{ add (key "service/web/port") 1 }}
```

```text
8081
```

### sub

`sub A B → int`

A minus B.

```gotemplate
{{ sub 10 3 }}
```

```text
7
```

### mul

`mul A B → int`

A times B.

```gotemplate
{{ mul 6 7 }}
```

```text
42
```

### mod

`mod A B → int`

A modulo B; fails on zero.

```gotemplate
{{ mod 10 4 }}
```

```text
2
```

### default

`default DEFAULT VALUE → any`

VALUE unless it is empty ("", 0, false, nil, empty list or map).

```gotemplate
{{ "" | default "none" }}
```

```text
none
```

### coalesce

`coalesce VALUES... → any`

First non-empty argument.

```gotemplate
{{ coalesce "" (keyOrDefault "x" "") "third" }}
```

```text
third
```

### dict

`dict K1 V1 ... → map[string]any`

Build a map from string keys and values; useful for toJSON / toYAML and for passing several values to a sub-template.

```gotemplate
{{ (dict "a" 1).a }}
```

```text
1
```

### list

`list VALUES... → []any`

Build a list.

```gotemplate
{{ len (list 1 2 3) }}
```

```text
3
```

### sortedKeys

`sortedKeys MAP → []string`

Sorted keys of a map or of a []KVPair. Ranging a map already sorts; this is for when you need the list itself.

```gotemplate
{{ sortedKeys (dict "b" 1 "a" 2) | join "," }}
```

```text
a,b
```

### values

`values PAIRS|MAP → []any`

Values of a []KVPair in order, or of a map sorted by key, as a plain list for join / toJSON / toYAML.

```gotemplate
{{ tree "service/web/hosts" | values | toJSON }}
```

```text
["10.0.0.1","10.0.0.2","nested"]
```

### fail

`fail MESSAGE`

Abort the render with MESSAGE. Nothing is written, the error is logged and counted, and /healthz turns 503. Use it to reject KV data that would produce a broken file.

```gotemplate
{{ if not (regexMatch "^[0-9]+$" (key "service/web/port")) }}{{ fail "port must be numeric" }}{{ end }}ok
```

```text
ok
```
